findingDetails.title: 5l interpolates raw routerPolicy.tieBreak entries into the doctor report
findingDetails.case: A routerPolicy.tieBreak entry containing a control character (an ANSI erase-line sequence, a carriage return, or an embedded newline) is printed verbatim by check 5l, so the rendered report can erase or fabricate lines and mislead the reader about which surface is misplaced.
findingDetails.recommendation: Filter C0/C1 control characters when interpolating config-derived strings into report text, centrally in the emit helpers or at minimum in 5l's FAIL message; add one adversarial test with a control-character entry.
